mapper.sql: sel.id, sel.student_id, sel.offering_id, sel.select_type, sel.select_time, sel.status, sel.remark, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, c.class_name AS className, cc.course_code AS courseCode, cc.course_name AS courseName, cc.credit AS credit, cc.course_type AS courseType, t.name AS teacherName, sem.semester_name AS semesterName

FROM course_selection sel INNER JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = sel.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sel.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_class c ON c.id = s.class_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tea_teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_semester sem ON sem.id = o.semester_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE sel.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND sel.status = 1 ORDER BY s.student_no ASC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(cc.credit), 0) FROM course_selection sel INNER JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = sel.offering_id AND o.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course_course cc ON cc.id = o.course_id AND cc.deleted = 0 WHERE sel.student_id = #{studentId} AND sel.status = 1 AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId}
